subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw expose and permanently support this Agentic OS-specific lease and metadata RPC contract in core, or should core provide only a generic extension seam owned by the downstream integration?
rationale: This is a new public Gateway, authorization, protocol-discovery, and persisted-state contract. The mechanical fixes are clear, but the permanent ownership and product boundary cannot be safely selected by automated review.

options.title: Use a generic core seam
options.body: Keep only generic authorization/observation primitives in core and move Agentic OS method names, metadata schema, and orchestration policy to the downstream owner integration.

options.title: Sponsor the core contract
options.body: Accept the named RPC surface as a supported OpenClaw API and assign an owner for its protocol versioning, upgrade behavior, documentation, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the new contract until a maintainer-approved external orchestration API proposal defines the supported boundary.

recommendation.title: Use a generic core seam
recommendation.body: Keep only generic authorization/observation primitives in core and move Agentic OS method names, metadata schema, and orchestration policy to the downstream owner integration.

likelyOwner.reason: The responsible current-main Gateway and state-schema owner must be identified from repository history/CODEOWNERS before deciding a permanent public API boundary.
